title: Dragon Enchantment Lamp Workshop
description: A mystical barn lamp sits on a pedestal, casting anisotropic light across a translucent dispersive dragon. The user must manipulate the lamp's position, color temperature, and intensity to charge the dragon through specific dispersion thresholds, unlocking spectral transformation stages that progressively alter the dragon's material properties.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads DragonDispersion.glb and AnisotropyBarnLamp.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the barn lamp on a wooden pedestal (BoxGeometry with brown MeshStandardMaterial) at world origin. Position the dragon model 3 units to the right, floating 0.5 units above a reflective circular platform (MeshPhysicalMaterial with metalness 1.0, roughness 0.1). Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at center, with OrbitControls for rotation only (disable pan and zoom). Add ambient light at intensity 0.15 and a PointLight parented to the lamp model simulating its emission. Implement these interactions: (1) Click the lamp to cycle through 5 color temperatures: warm-2700K, neutral-4000K, cool-5500K, violet-7500K, ultraviolet-9000K, each mapped to hex colors. (2) Use a mouse wheel over the lamp to adjust light intensity from 0.5 to 5.0 in 0.5 increments, displayed in a HUD div overlay. (3) Click-and-drag the lamp pedestal left/right along the X-axis between -4 and 4 units, with the point light following. (4) When intensity exceeds 3.0 and color is violet or ultraviolet, the dragon's material transmission property animates from 0.2 to 0.9 over 2 seconds. (5) At each dispersion threshold crossing (transmission at 0.4, 0.6, 0.8), spawn a ring of 12 small emissive spheres orbiting the dragon that match the current lamp color. (6) Once all three rings are active, enable a final click on the dragon that triggers a particle burst using 200 small spheres exploding outward with randomized velocities, then the dragon's material shifts to iridescence 1.0 with a rainbow sheen. Track all parameter states in a validation object. Display a minimal HUD showing current intensity, color mode, transmission level, and rings activated. Add a reset button that restores all initial states. Use requestAnimationFrame for the render loop and animate orbiting rings with sine-based vertical oscillation.
